blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 了解长视频需要查找证据,解决视觉细节,并将观测结果纳入答案。 即使在存在相关证据的情况下,在漫长而密集的视觉序列中进行这些操作也会给感知和推理带来负担. 视频代理可以进行选择性检查,但将帧还给计划员仍然会在其推理背景中积累视觉信息. 授权感知减轻了这一负担,但很少采样可能会错过决定性的细节,而按框架描述可以保持上下文的增长. 我们引入了VideoNexus,这是一个无培训的框架,它将详细的视频感知与由证据驱动的规划和推理区分开来. 计划者控制检查地点, 解决什么, 和如何密集的采样。 感知子代理在独立的情况下处理本地音频视频,并压缩返回,基于时间的证据进行迭代搜索和核实. 使用双子座 3.8 Flash进行规划和感知,VideoNexus在全LV Bench上达到88.6%的精度,分别以3.6分和1.1分超过同背骨静地摄取和内置代理处理,以后者所测API成本的44%. 成对的LV Bench子集的活化显示出较低的计划器输入和更高的精度. 由于Kimi K3是共享的骨干,VideoNexus在我们的评价中比官方的Video-GAIA ReAct利用率提高了8.5分. 这些成果有助于进行紧凑的证据交流,将详细观察与有效的规划和推理结合起来。

blocks.en:
Understanding a long video involves finding the evidence that matters to a question, examining its visual details, and reasoning about how observations fit together.
These operations are closely related: an initial observation may suggest a location to revisit, a detail to verify, or a new question to resolve.
Even when all relevant evidence is included in the input, a model must locate and interpret it among substantial amounts of unrelated visual information.
A one-hour video sampled at one frame per second produces hundreds of thousands of visual tokens [ 36 ] . Static ingestion places evidence localization, perception and reasoning within this shared multimodal context [ 13 , 2 ] ; denser input provides more detail but also increases the information the model must process together.
blocks.zh:
了解一段长长的视频,需要找到对某个问题很重要的证据,检查其视觉细节,并推理观察如何结合在一起。
这些行动密切相关:初步观察可能表明需要重新审视的地点、需要核实的细节或需要解决的新问题。
即使输入中包含所有相关证据,模型也必须在大量无关的视觉信息中查找和解释.
以每秒一帧抽取一个小时的视频,可产生数十万个视觉符号[36]. 静态摄入将证据本地化、感知和推理置于这种共同的多式联运背景[13、2];更密集的投入提供了更详细的信息,但也增加了模型必须共同处理的信息。

blocks.en:
Video agents allow this process to unfold through interaction: the model chooses where to look, evaluates the returned evidence, and decides whether another observation is needed [ 37 , 9 , 38 , 56 ] .
EVA [ 58 ] learns query-driven observation policies, and VideoTemp-o3 [ 22 ] jointly learns temporal grounding and question answering with localization refinement. Alongside these advances in selecting observations, the interface that delivers them to the reasoning context remains consequential.
When tools return raw frames or clips directly to the planner, visual inputs accumulate in the context that also guides subsequent actions and integrates evidence ( figure 1 a).
Adaptive selection changes which media is read, but the planner continues to process that media alongside its reasoning history.
In our controlled comparison, this coupled design uses 1.47 × \times as much planner input as returning evidence from independent perception calls ( section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
视频代理可以让这一过程通过互动展开:模型选择看哪里,评价返回的证据,并决定是否需要另外的观察[37,9,38,56].
EVA [58] 学习查询驱动的观测政策,VideoTemp-o3 [22] 结合本地化的完善,共同学习时间定位和问答. 除了在选择观测结果方面取得这些进展之外,向推理背景提供观测结果的界面仍然具有必然作用。
当工具将原始帧或剪辑直接归还给规划者时,视觉投入在上下文中累积,同时引导后续行动并整合证据(图1a).
媒体被读取的适应性选择改变,
在我们的控制比较中,这种组合式设计使用1.47×\时与独立感知调用返回证据一样多的规划器输入(第4.4节)。

blocks.en:
Delegating perception to separate models addresses this context burden and is already established in video agents.
VideoSeek [ 17 ] and VideoXAgent [ 45 ] , for example, allow a planner to act on textual observations.
Two issues remain.
First, sparse sampling can omit brief events or fine details needed to verify an answer, motivating inspection at a density appropriate to the local task.
Second, a text interface can preserve the dependence between observation size and sampling density.
VideoSeek’s global scan returns one description per frame, averaging 28 returned tokens per frame read in our re-run ( section 4.5 ).
Increasing its scan budget would therefore also lengthen the report retained for reasoning.
Separating model calls alone does not determine either how closely the agent can inspect a moment or how much information it must carry forward.
blocks.zh:
将感知委托给不同的模型处理这种背景负担,已经在视频代理中确立。
例如,VideoSeek [17]和VideoXAgent [45] 允许计划人员就文字观察采取行动.
尚有两个问题。
首先,零星的抽样可以省略简短的事件或核实答案所需的细微细节,促使检查密度与当地任务相称。
第二,文本接口可以保持观测大小和取样密度之间的依赖性。
VideoSeek的全球扫描每帧返回一个描述,
因此,增加其扫描预算也将延长保留的报告的篇幅,以供推理。
单靠分拆型号的呼叫不能决定代理人能够在多大程度上仔细检查某一时刻,也不能确定代理人必须传递多少信息。

blocks.en:
We study how to give video agents access to detailed observations while controlling what each observation adds to the reasoning context.
The required detail varies across the process: broad exploration locates candidate moments, while local verification may require denser sampling around a specific event.
This motivates treating each perception call as a focused evidence-gathering task, with its location and sampling density chosen by the planner and its output organized around the question being resolved.
blocks.zh:
我们研究如何让视频代理访问详细观察,同时控制每次观察会增加推理背景的内容.
整个过程所需的详细情况各不相同:广泛的勘探可以找到可供选择的时刻,而当地核查则可能需要围绕某一特定事件进行更密集的取样。
这促使人们将每个感官呼唤视为重点收集证据的任务,其地点和采样密度由规划者选择,其产出围绕正在解决的问题组织。

blocks.en:
We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework for video perception beyond the reasoning context ( figure 1 b).
The Planner formulates local tasks, selects intervals and sampling rates, integrates returned evidence, and decides when to stop.
Perception sub-agents examine native audio–video in independent, short-lived contexts.
Overview returns a compact set of candidate intervals for navigation; Inspect returns a Finding with claims anchored to the absolute source timeline and explicit evidence or uncertainty status.
Both global and local reports limit the information returned instead of describing every sampled frame.
In the final configuration, small local evidence cards accompany visual findings for verification.
The planner can thus request further detail without retaining the complete perceptual input from each call.
VideoNexus runs on a stock agent runtime with Model Context Protocol tools and requires no training.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了VideoNexus,这是超越推理背景的视频感知的无培训框架(图1b).
规划员制定本地任务,选择间隔和采样率,整合返回证据,决定何时停止.
感知子剂在独立,短命的语境中检查本地音频-视频.
概览返回一组紧凑的可供选择的导航间隔; 检查返回一个查找,其中包含基于绝对源时间线和明确证据或不确定性状态的索赔。
全球和地方报告都限制返回的信息,而不是说明每个抽样框架。
在最后的配置中,小型的当地证据卡随附可视结果进行核查.
因此,规划者可以要求进一步的细节,而不保留每个呼叫的完整感知输入.
VideoNexus 运行在持有模式背景协议工具的股票代理运行时间上,不需要培训.

blocks.en:
Our experiments examine context use, observation size and task performance.
With Gemini 3.8 Flash as the shared backbone, a paired LVBench ablation reduces planner input by 32% while increasing accuracy from 86.5% to 89.0% in that run.
On full LVBench [ 36 ] , VideoNexus achieves 88.6%, compared with 85.0% for static ingestion and 87.5% for Gemini’s agentic mode, at 44% of the latter’s measured API cost.
It reads 621 frames per question on average and outperforms a same-backbone VideoSeek re-run by 7.2 points at lower cost; the comparison also differs in audio access, analyzed in the supplementary material.
With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone on Video-GAIA [ 53 ] , it improves over the official ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation; further experiments examine transfer across planner models.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验考察了背景使用情况,观测大小和任务性能.
双子座3.8 作为共享主干线的闪电,一对LV Bench lablation将规划员输入减少32%,同时将精度从86.5%提高到89.0%。
在全LV Bench [36] 上,VideoNexus取得了88.6%的成绩,而静电摄入率为85.0%,双子座的代理模式为87.5%,占后者测量的API成本的44%.
平均每个问题读取621帧,以较低的成本比同一背骨视频Seek重运行7.2点;在音频访问方面,比较也有所不同,在补充材料中进行了分析。
Kimi K3是Video-GAIA[53]的共享骨干,它比官方的ReAct(ReAct)在我们的评价中提高了8.5分;进一步的实验考察了跨计划模型的转移.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We analyze the coupling between video observation and reasoning context, including how per-frame text can preserve this dependence after perception is delegated. • We introduce VideoNexus, combining planner-directed perception with bounded, temporally grounded evidence exchange for global exploration and local verification. • We evaluate the design through controlled ablations and per-call measurements, together with same-backbone accuracy–cost comparisons and transfer experiments.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们分析视频观察和推理背景之间的结合,包括每个框架文本如何在感知被授权后保持这种依赖性。 我们介绍了VideoNexus,将规划师指导的认知与有限度的、基于时间的证据交换结合起来,促进全球探索和地方核查。 我们通过受控的涂片和按呼测量,以及同背骨精度-成本比较和转移实验来评估设计。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Frontier MLLMs accept long native videos [ 13 , 7 , 2 , 15 ] ; other work extends context [ 55 ] or compresses visual tokens [ 32 ] . Long-video benchmarks expose difficulties in retrieving and reasoning over detailed evidence [ 11 , 41 , 36 ] , and required sampling density varies across questions [ 29 ] . Text-only studies likewise show that access to a long context does not ensure effective use of its contents [ 19 ] .
Real-time systems support full-duplex audiovisual interaction [ 8 ] or parallel listening, writing and speaking [ 54 ] , addressing interaction constraints distinct from long-video evidence search.
Language-mediated representations [ 50 , 51 ] and searchable video memories [ 25 , 37 , 9 , 56 , 3 ] organize evidence for later reasoning. Several methods combine initial representations with query-conditioned retrieval, refinement or inspection [ 26 , 38 , 49 , 23 ] ; they are not uniformly fixed, question-independent indices. Sequential memory construction [ 4 , 5 ] and compositional visual programs [ 33 , 14 , 27 ] offer further ways to structure perception.
Precomputed representations can amortize work across questions, while query-time inspection can revisit details omitted from the initial representation. We focus on the interface between such inspection and the planner’s reasoning context.
blocks.zh:
Frontier MLLMs接受长篇本土视频[13,7,2,15];其他作品扩展上下文[55]或压缩视觉符号[32]. 长视频基准暴露了对详细证据的检索和推理方面的困难[11、41、36],要求的取样密度因问题而异[29]。 同样,仅以文字为主的研究显示,进入一个长的语境并不能确保有效使用其内容[19]。
实时系统支持全复式视听互动[8]或并行的听、写和说话[54],解决不同于长视频证据搜索的互动制约。
以语言为媒介的表述[50,51]和可搜索的视频记忆[25,37,9,56,3]为以后的推理整理证据. 几种方法将初步表述与有查询条件的检索、改进或检查[26、38、49、23]结合起来;它们不是统一固定的、独立的问题指数。 序列记忆构造[4,5]和组成视觉程序[33,14,27]提供了进一步的结构感知的方法.
预先计算的陈述可以分期摊还各个问题的工作,而查询时间检查可以重温初始陈述中遗漏的细节. 我们把重点放在这种检查与规划者的推理背景之间的相互联系上。

blocks.en:
OmniAgent [ 42 ] learns active perception; EVA [ 58 ] trains a summary–plan–action–reflection loop; and VideoTemp-o3 [ 22 ] jointly trains temporal grounding and question answering with localization refinement.
VideoSEAL [ 28 ] separates planning from final answer authority for visual verification, whereas VideoLoop [ 43 ] provides plug-and-play working-memory rewriting. These address different parts of an agent’s evidence-processing pipeline.
In adjacent settings, Thyme [ 57 ] learns image-processing code for visual reasoning, SpatialReward [ 24 ] uses explicit spatial reasoning to evaluate image edits, and DeltaVid [ 46 ] improves fine-grained video perception through cross-video difference supervision.
VideoNexus studies a training-free observation interface. Learned policies, improved perception and compact evidence exchange are complementary; our experiments do not compare against these trained policies.
blocks.zh:
OmniAgent [42] 学习主动感知; EVA [58] 训练一个摘要-计划-行动-反射环;和 VideoTemp-o3 [22] 联合训练时间定位和提问解答与本地化完善.
VideoSEL [28] 将规划与最终的答题权限分开进行视觉验证,而VideoLoop [43] 则提供插件和游戏工作记忆重写. 它们涉及代理人证据处理管道的不同部分。
在相邻的设置中,Thyme [57]学习图像处理代码用于视觉推理,SpaceReward [24]使用明确的空间推理来评价图像编辑,DeltaVid [46]通过跨视频差异监督改进了精细的视频感知.
VideoNexus研究无培训观测界面. 所学到的政策、改善的认识和紧凑的证据交流是相辅相成的;我们的实验与这些训练有素的政策没有可比性。

blocks.en:
Recent agents combine query-conditioned observation with tool orchestration. AVP [ 39 ] separates coarse scanning from detailed inspection; VideoResearcher [ 48 ] evolves tools through solving and tool-refinement loops; VideoXAgent [ 45 ] integrates a broad tool set; and VideoSeek [ 17 ] navigates through overview, skim and focus operations.
Related approaches explore multi-agent coordination, observation routing and task-specific tools [ 44 , 35 , 12 , 52 , 34 , 10 , 16 ] ; GoP-Agent [ 6 ] exploits compressed-video motion information. These systems differ in their memory and observation interfaces.
Delegated perception is established practice. Our focus is how returned reports scale with media inspected during global navigation and local verification. In our VideoSeek re-run, global scanning returns per-frame descriptions, while local focus already returns a concise answer. VideoNexus returns up to eight candidate intervals from Overview and task-specific Findings from Inspect; section 4.5 measures their output growth.
LAVE [ 40 ] instead injects latent visual evidence into reasoning. Our main configuration also retains limited visual evidence through small cards, while explicit uncertainty can prompt further inspection.
blocks.zh:
近期的代理将查询条件观测与工具管弦结合. AVP [39] 将粗扫描与详细检查区分开来; VideoResearcher [48] 通过解析和工具精细循环来演化工具; VideoXAgent [45] 集成了一个广泛的工具集; VideoSeek [17] 通过概览,滑行和焦点操作来导航.
相关方法探索多代理协调,观测路径和任务特定工具[44,35,12,52,34,10,16];GOP-Agent [6]利用压缩-视频运动信息. 这些系统在内存和观察界面上有所不同.
授权感知是惯例。 我们的重点是,在全球导航和当地核查期间,回送的报告如何以媒体检查的规模扩大。 在我们的VideoSeek重新运行中,全局扫描返回每帧描述,而本地焦点已经返回一个简明的答案. VideoNexus从Overview和Inspect特定任务结果中返回最多8个候选间隔;第4.5节测量其产出增长.
LAVE[40]转而为推理注入潜在的视觉证据. 我们的主要配置也通过小卡片保留有限的视觉证据,而明显的不确定性可以促使进一步检查.

blocks.en:
OpenAI’s o3 reasons with images, and Gemini provides agentic video processing. The Qwen3.8-Omni report [ 30 ] also evaluates agentic video understanding. Open-world agents combine video reasoning with research [ 21 ] ; VideoDR [ 18 ] and Video-GAIA [ 53 ] provide benchmarks with ReAct-style baselines [ 47 ] .
Static ingestion remains competitive [ 31 ] , motivating our same-backbone static comparison. TRACE [ 20 ] evaluates visual evidence coverage. REPAIR [ 1 ] highlights variation across repeated agent executions: our full-set paired tests address within-run differences, not repeat-run reproducibility.
Anthropic’s multi-agent research system also delegates research to sub-agents that return condensed results. VideoNexus examines this design for video, where the detail of each observation and the size of its report can be controlled separately.
blocks.zh:
OpenAI的o3理由与图像,双子座提供代理视频处理. Qwen3.8-Omni报告[30]也评价了代理视频理解. 开放世界代理商将视频推理与研究相结合[21];视频DR[18]和视频-GAIA[53]提供了带有ReAct风格基线的基准[47].
静脉摄入仍然具有竞争力 [31], 激励我们同样的背骨静态比较。 TRACE [20] 评价视觉证据覆盖. REPAIR [1] 突出强调了重复执行的代理人处决的不同:我们完全设定的配对测试处理的是运行内的差异,而不是重复运行的可重复性.
Anthropic的多剂研究系统也将研究委托给返回浓缩结果的子剂. VideoNexus为视频检查这种设计,其中每次观测的细节和报告大小可以单独控制.

blocks.en: 3.1 Coupled and decoupled multimodal contexts
blocks.zh: 3.1 结合和脱钩的多式联运背景

blocks.en:
VideoNexus consists of a Planner that never receives the video stream and a set of perception sub-agents exposed as tools ( figure 2 ; a schematic and the full tool list are in the supplementary material).
The Planner receives the question and a short policy (a “skill” of about ten sentences) that imposes no fixed call order and states that transcripts may contain errors, that Overview returns navigation clues rather than evidence, that visual claims require visual evidence, and to stop once the answer is supported.
Every perception call runs an independent model call on native media, in a context that is discarded afterwards.

blocks.en:
Transcribe runs ASR once per video, independently of the question, and returns segments with absolute times; it is cached and shared across questions. Overview performs a query-conditioned, globally sparse scan of the native video (at most 1 fps and 1,024 frames, at low resolution, with the full audio track) and returns a short summary and up to eight candidate intervals, each with an observation, a relevance estimate and an uncertainty note.
Its prompt states that sparse sampling cannot establish absence and forbids choosing an answer option, so Overview is a locator , not a judge; it is limited to two calls per question. Inspect , the main evidence source, reads an interval [ s , e ] [s,e] at a frame rate chosen by the Planner, with an open-ended local task such as “describe what the person places on the red armchair and when”.
The skill asks the Planner to phrase local tasks neutrally, and the perception prompt forbids selecting an option of the parent question, so a Finding reports what the interval shows rather than echoing the Planner’s hypothesis.
For open-world questions the same pattern extends to source-resolution crops and to web search and page extraction [ 53 ] ; the LVBench runs use only Transcribe, Overview and Inspect (with crops).

blocks.en: 3.3 The Finding protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 查找协议

blocks.en:
Each Inspect call returns a JSON Finding with a status ∈ \in { ok , absent , uncertain , failed }, where absent refers only to the sampled observation; a one-sentence conclusion ; what was observed ; and evidence items { claim , [ t 0 , t 1 ] , modality } \{\textit{claim},[t_{0},t_{1}],\textit{modality}\} with modality ∈ \in {visual, audio, audio_visual} and times on the absolute source timeline.
The harness validates every Finding: evidence whose time range falls outside the inspected interval is dropped, and an ok status without remaining evidence is downgraded to uncertain .
This validates structure and temporal range, not factual correctness. Overview caps candidates at eight; Inspect has no eight-item cap. Both have a generation budget independent of frame count. Bounded evidence exchange refers to this budget and compact report design; section 4.5 measures actual output growth.

The final configuration returns each visual Finding with an evidence card : a single contact sheet containing at most six source frames selected from its cited evidence intervals, each labeled with its absolute time. Dense video and audio remain in the perception context.
The card grows with evidence, not with inspected duration; on full LVBench it amounts to 3.3 images and 2% of the Planner’s input tokens per question, with model-dependent effects on accuracy ( section 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.4 Native timeline addressing and implementation
blocks.zh: 3.4 处理和实施本地时间表

blocks.en:
Perception calls reference the original video file with start and end offsets and a frame rate, instead of cutting and re-encoding clips, and the perception model then reports times on the original timeline: in a probe with neutral prompts, all 12 responses returned absolute source times, while a physically cropped clip returned times relative to its own start (the supplementary material).
Findings from different calls, the transcript and the Overview can therefore be compared directly.
Each question runs in an isolated headless Claude Code session whose only built-in tool is the skill loader; perception tools are served over the Model Context Protocol, and a local bridge routes the Planner to any provider, replaying Gemini’s thought signatures across turns.
Unless stated otherwise, the Planner and sub-agents share the model and high thinking effort, with at most 32 turns, 256 frames per Inspect and 10 local calls. Cumulative-budget implementation and observed usage are detailed in the supplementary material.
The harness requires no training and no access to model weights.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
LVBench [ 36 ] contains 1,549 four-way multiple-choice questions on 103 hour-scale videos in six categories: entity recognition (ER, 560), event understanding (EU, 526), key information retrieval (KIR, 196), reasoning (Rea, 147), summarization (Sum, 55) and temporal grounding (TG, 65).
We report accuracy on the full set and count invalid outputs as wrong.
Ablations use a fixed 200-question development subset stratified by category and covering all 103 videos ( dev-200 ); they are paired comparisons inside that subset, while the main Gemini 3.8 system comparison uses the full set, including these development questions. Video-GAIA [ 53 ] contains 271 open-ended questions (L1: 62, L2: 209) whose answers require video evidence and web search; both arms are scored by one binary semantic judge (Kimi K3) with the same prompt and reference answers (the supplementary material).

我们报告整套数据的准确性,并将无效产出算作错误。

blocks.en:
The main experiments use Gemini 3.8 Flash for both the Planner and perception, with high thinking effort and low media resolution; cross-model experiments use Gemini 3.0 Flash and Kimi K3.
Hosted models are accessed through APIs; the reported backbone is shared across the main comparison. Static feeds the whole native video with audio in one call at 1 fps, capped at 2,048 frames. Gemini Agentic is Google’s server-side agentic media-processing mode with high thinking; it reports the media it navigates as image tokens, from which we estimate 464 frames per question (the supplementary material). VideoSeek [ 17 ] is re-run from its official code on the same Gemini 3.8 Flash back-end at its published perception budget, with its own prompts, tools and budgets; we drive it through the provider’s native interface with thought signatures replayed, without which over half of its steps return empty (the supplementary material).
VideoSeek has no audio path, and LVBench ships no subtitles, so it never receives speech; we quantify this asymmetry in the supplementary material.
On Video-GAIA we run the official ReAct agent , which keeps 20 uniformly sampled frames in context.

Against the VideoSeek re-run, which also delegates perception, VideoNexus is correct on 153 questions VideoSeek misses and wrong on 42 it answers (88.6% against 81.4%, p = 5 × 10 − 16 p{=}5{\times}10^{-16} ).
This is a system comparison: observation format, sampling, native audio access and media transport all differ.
The two use similar fresh input token counts per question, 118.2k for VideoSeek and 118.7k for VideoNexus ( figure 3 b), while processing 123 still-image frames and 621 native-video frames with audio, respectively.
They differ in generated output: VideoSeek emits 26.2k tokens per question against our 12.4k, and output is billed at five times the fresh-input price, accounting for most of the cost difference.
Repricing VideoSeek at the cheapest image tier gives $0.140 per question; this is a pricing sensitivity analysis with accuracy held fixed, not another measured configuration (the supplementary material).
VideoNexus also needs fewer model calls, 9.7 per question (6.1 planner turns, 3.6 perception calls) against 18.6.
It leads in five of six categories, by 2.7 points on reasoning and 3.6 on summarization; temporal grounding is the exception (92.3 against 90.8 for Gemini Agentic, one question).
Much of the remaining headroom is shared: 122 of VideoNexus’s 177 errors are also errors of both Static and Gemini Agentic.

We measure how strongly the size of a returned observation grows with the media inspected. Figure 4 measures it on every perception call of the full run (per-tool table in the supplementary material).
Overview consumes 141k media tokens on average, 1,019 frames plus the complete audio track, and returns 740 tokens, a 191 × \times reduction, with a log–log slope of 0.00 0.00 against perceived tokens ( r = 0.01 r{=}0.01 ), indicating little association within the observed range. inspect_frames , which is asked for detail, grows sub-linearly with slope 0.18 0.18 : between its lowest and highest decile of perceived media, frames rise 16.8 × \times while returned text rises 1.67 × \times (308 → \rightarrow 514 tokens).
Overview limits its candidate list, and Inspect answers a local task in a structured report. These measurements support weak output growth; they do not establish constant output size or calibrated confidence.
VideoSeek’s scanning tools return approximately one description per frame: 63.8 descriptions per 64-frame overview and 14.4 per 16-frame skim , or 28 and 63 returned tokens per frame read. Its query-answering focus returns 4.4 tokens per frame and is also concise.
This baseline already uses concise local answers; the measured distinction is in the reports used for global navigation.
In the full run, perception reads 621 frames per question on average, while the Planner’s context at its final turn holds 19.6k tokens on average, system prompt and skill included.

At one frame per minute, a scan sees the evidence of only about half of the questions, and of 28% of the key-information questions, which hinge on brief on-screen text or objects; VideoSeek reports that removing its overview costs 13.3 points [ 17 ] , so the global scan carries much of the navigation.

To measure density directly, we re-run the benchmark configuration on dev-200 with two numbers set to VideoSeek’s budget: Overview capped at 64 frames and inspect_frames at 16 frames per call.
Perception then reads 117 frames per question on average instead of 621, and accuracy falls from 90.0% to 87.0% (8 lost, 2 gained, p = 0.11 p{=}0.11 ).
The reduced-budget run costs $0.143 against $0.140 per question, and uses more planner calls and output tokens: 8.0 planner calls instead of 6.1 and 15.3k output tokens instead of 12.4k.
The nominal accuracy difference is not significant; the cost figures also compare this subset run with the full-run average. They suggest a trade-off between observation size and subsequent interaction, rather than cost-free dense perception.
VideoNexus’s lead over VideoSeek is also largest where the evidence window is short (the supplementary material), the direction coverage predicts.

blocks.en: 4.8 Failure modes
blocks.zh: 4.8 失败模式

blocks.en:
On the 153 questions VideoSeek misses and VideoNexus answers, VideoSeek takes 8.5 steps against its 6.2 average and scans globally first on 76%. Continued interaction does not always resolve missing evidence; sampling and action-selection effects remain intertwined.
On the 42 that go the other way our trajectories run long, 9.7 turns against a typical 6.1, with Overview used on 29 of them and skipped on 13. Local inspection can therefore remain unsuccessful even after a global scan.
On Video-GAIA, 26 of 28 inspected cases find the right interval, while crops are readable enough to identify the target in 16 of 27 cases. This small qualitative sample points to spatial readability as a remaining difficulty.
blocks.zh:
在153个问题上, VideoSeek 错过和 VideoNexus 回答, VideoSeek 采取8.5步骤, 相对于它的6.2平均值, 持续的互动并不总是解决缺失的证据;抽样和行动选择效应仍然相互交织。
在相反的42场比赛中,我们的轨迹跑得很长,9.7与典型的6.1相对应,其中29场使用"概览",13场跳过. 因此,即使在进行全球扫描之后,地方检查仍然可能不成功。
在视频-GAIA中,28个被检查的病例中有26个找到正确的间隔,而农作物足够可读,可识别27个病例中的16个。 这种小的定性样本指出空间可读性是剩下的一个困难.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Long-video agents must decide both what to observe and what to retain for reasoning.
VideoNexus supports this process through planner-directed perception in independent contexts and compact, temporally grounded reports for global navigation and local verification.
The paired ablation reduces planner input while increasing accuracy in that run, and per-call measurements show slowly growing reports across full LVBench.
With Gemini 3.8 Flash, it reaches 88.6% on LVBench at 44% of the built-in agentic mode’s measured API cost. With Kimi K3, it improves over the official Video-GAIA harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation.
These results support focused evidence exchange for video agents, subject to imperfect perception and the development and comparison limits discussed in the supplementary material.
The visual-memory ablations motivate retaining selected evidence for verification alongside text reports. Future work should examine how observation density and retained evidence adapt to uncertainty across tasks and model capabilities.
blocks.zh:
长视频代理必须同时决定观察什么和保留什么用于推理.
VideoNexus通过规划者在独立背景下的定向感知以及紧凑的、基于时间的报告来支持这一进程,供全球导航和地方核查之用。
配对的衰减减少了规划员的投入,同时提高了运行中的精度,每一次呼叫的测量显示,整个LV Bench的报告缓慢增长.
双子座3.8 Flash,它以内置代理模式所测API成本的44%在LV Bench上达到88.6%. 有了Kimi K3,它比官方的Video-GAIA控制器在我们的评估中提高了8.5分.
这些结果支持有重点地交流视频代理的证据,但需遵守补充材料中所讨论的不完善的认知以及开发和比较限制。
视觉记忆事件促使在文本报告的同时保留某些证据进行核查。 今后的工作应审查观测密度和保留证据如何适应不同任务和模型能力的不确定性。

It reports the media it navigated as IMAGE tokens under toolUsePromptTokenCount , never as video or audio, and for 92% of the questions that count is an exact multiple of 66, the per-frame cost of low-resolution video, so the navigated frames enter the planning model’s own context as images ( appendix L ).
Dividing by 66 estimates 464 frames per question on average (median 150, maximum 12,106), which describes its observation volume without isolating the cause of its cost.

blocks.en:
Its agent asks the model for a plain-text thought and then makes a second, tool-enabled call to parse that text into actions, so the function calls in its history are synthesized locally rather than returned by the provider.
That design also asks for a plan in prose with no tools attached, and on this back-end an unconstrained turn answers such a prompt with a call to one of the provider’s own built-in video tools instead, which reaches an OpenAI-style client as empty content: over half of the agent’s steps then come back with an empty thought (57.6% of its thoughts were lost when run that way), and its planner falls back to re-issuing the same overview until the step budget runs out.
Gemini 3 also attaches an opaque thought signature to each model turn, and replaying a function call without it is rejected.
We therefore drive the baseline through the native streamGenerateContent interface, declare function calling off on exactly the turns VideoSeek means to be tool-free, replay each model turn with the signature it was issued, and flatten the locally synthesized call envelope, whose action text each observation already restates verbatim.

这个设计也要求有一个没有工具附加的传教计划, 在这个后端, 一个不受约束的转弯回答, 呼唤提供商自己的内置视频工具,

因此,我们通过本地流GenerateContent接口驱动基线,宣布功能在VideoSeek表示的完全关闭的转折上无工具,用它发出的签名重放每个模型转折,并平整本地合成的呼叫信封,其动作文本每个观察已经逐字重复了.

blocks.en: Appendix C Cost accounting

blocks.en:
Static has cross-question cache hits because its video prefix repeats across questions on the same video; we reprice those hits as fresh input.
The two agentic rows have none: over all 1,549 questions, the first model call of a question is billed with zero cached tokens for both VideoNexus and the VideoSeek re-run, so every cache hit either one gets is a hit on its own question’s history and is kept.
Pricing those within-question hits as fresh as well would read $0.184 for VideoNexus and $0.201 for VideoSeek, a 1.09 × \times ratio instead of 1.34 × \times ; the ordering survives either basis.

blocks.en:
The provider bills the two transports differently: 66 tokens per frame for a native video stream at low resolution, against a per-image-part resolution tier for stills (264, 527, 1.1k and 2.2k prompt tokens per part, independent of the pixels in it) that VideoSeek leaves at its 1.1k-token default.
The measured cost therefore reflects both harness behavior and provider-specific media pricing.
Repricing every image part VideoSeek sent at each tier, and changing nothing else, gives $0.252 per question at the most expensive tier, $0.188 as it ran, $0.155 one tier down and $0.140 at the cheapest, against $0.140 for VideoNexus.
At the cheapest tier the repriced costs are equal. Setting image charges to zero gives VideoSeek $0.125 per question, 89% of our cost; both calculations retain its measured accuracy.
The repricing holds accuracy fixed without validating that assumption: its overview packs eight frames into a single montage image, so the cheapest tier would leave those eight frames 264 tokens between them, and its focus sends frames at full resolution in order to resolve detail. An arm measuring the accuracy cost of that tier is the one reprice we have not run.
At the measured tier, the two harnesses use similar fresh input token counts, 118.2k fresh tokens per question against 118.7k, and differ 2.1 × \times in output, which is priced at five times input; output is 52% of VideoSeek’s bill and 33% of ours.
All dollar figures are list prices of one model and should not be carried to another provider.

blocks.en:
We compare the coverage calculation with descriptive performance slices from the two harnesses on the same questions ( figure 6 ).
We slice the 1,534 questions for which LVBench annotates an evidence window by the length of that window and by whether our cached transcript places speech inside it.
The six slices hold the 1,148 questions whose window has positive length and whose video has a cached transcript; another 213 questions with a transcript have a window annotated as a single timestamp and enter only the pooled speech/no-speech comparison.
VideoNexus leads in every one of the six slices, by between 1.8 and 10.3 points against an overall 7.3.
The single-timestamp questions are not uniformly favourable: on the 69 of them without speech VideoSeek is ahead (85.5% against 82.6%), while on the 144 with speech VideoNexus is (88.9% against 77.1%).
blocks.zh:
我们把覆盖面的计算与这两个方面在同样问题上的描述性表现片进行对比(图6)。
我们切除1 534个问题, LV Bench根据窗口的长度以及我们保存的文字记录是否将语音放在窗口内, 来说明证据窗口。
六个切片手持1,148个问题,其窗口长度为正,视频有缓存的笔录;另外213个带有笔录的提问有一个窗口,作为单个时间戳加注,只输入集合的语音/无语音比较.
VideoNexus在6个切片中每一个都领先,比整体7.3的比分在1.8到10.3点之间.
单时标的问题并不一致:在其中69个没有演讲的视频Seek中领先(85.5%对82.6%),而在144个有演讲的视频Nexus中领先(88.9%对77.1%)。

blocks.en:
Two things separate the slices, and only one of them is density.
The lead is largest where the evidence window is short: 10.3 points on windows of at most 10 s with speech and 7.0 on the 114 short windows without it, against 1.8 on 10–30 s windows without speech, the direction coverage predicts, since a short window is what a sparse uniform scan steps over.
The other split is the lead of 8.7 points where speech falls inside the window (89.7 against 81.0 on 1,077 questions) against 3.9 where it does not (85.2 against 81.3 on 284).
Audio access differs between the systems, and the slices also differ in question content. This descriptive comparison cannot separate the contributions of density and modality.
These slices are descriptive and do not isolate a causal contribution of density.
blocks.zh:
两样东西分开切片,只有一种是密度.
在证据窗口短处,领先最大:在最多10s的窗口上10.3分,在114个短窗口上7.0分,而在10至30个短窗口上1.8分,没有语音,方向覆盖预言,因为短窗口是一个稀疏的统一扫描步骤。
另一种分歧是8.7分的领先点,即话语落在窗口内(89.7对1 077个问题的81.0),而不是3.9,没有(85.2对284个问题的81.3).
各系统之间音频访问不同,切片内容也不同. 这种描述性比较不能将密度和方式的贡献分开。
这些片段是描述性的,并不孤立密度的因果关系。

blocks.en:
The density ablation of section 4.6 is paired on the question: all 200 dev questions at VideoSeek’s budget against the same questions inside the full benchmark run, with 172 right in both.
The 90.0% density control is the four-tool benchmark configuration with evidence cards, evaluated on these 200 questions within the full run. The coupling comparison in table 3 a uses the earlier three-tool configuration without cards. Comparing those two configurations alone would not isolate the effect of cards. The visual-memory comparison is reported separately in table 3 b; its Gemini 3.8 row uses the aggregate counts described below.
Scan coverage bounds what a single global scan can discover, not what the agent can answer, since speech and the transcript offer a second route to the same evidence; this is why we present coverage as a discoverability proxy and the ablation as the accuracy measurement.
blocks.zh:
第4.6节的密度下降是问题所在:在VideoSeek预算中,所有200个非问题都与整个基准运行中的相同问题相对应,其中172个问题都正确。
90.0%的密度控制是带有证据卡的四工具基准配置,在全程范围内对这200个问题进行评估. 表 3 a 中的组合比较使用早先的三工具配置,没有卡片。 仅比较这两种配置并不能孤立卡片的效果。 表3b中单独报告了视觉-记忆比较;其双子座3.8行采用下文所述总数。
扫描覆盖范围限制了单一全球扫描能够发现的事物,而不是代理人能够回答的事物,因为语音和文字记录提供了通往相同证据的第二条途径;这就是为什么我们把覆盖范围作为可发现性代用,把衰竭作为精确度测量。

blocks.en: Appendix F Visual memory in the planner’s context
blocks.zh: 附录F 规划者背景中的视觉记忆

blocks.en:
Table 3 b reports the card ablations in the main paper. The Gemini 3.0 comparison holds the earlier harness and dev-200 questions fixed, changing whether local evidence cards and global Overview frames enter the planner. Local cards improve accuracy by 5 points; adding global frames reduces it by 4 points. The Gemini 3.8 comparison records 178 correct answers without cards and 180 with cards on dev-200, a 1-point gain. Only aggregate correct-answer counts are available for the Gemini 3.8 card comparison, so no discordant-pair counts or paired significance test are reported for it. These within-backbone results support compact local visual memory, but the earlier Gemini 3.0 harness differs from the Gemini 3.8 configuration and does not isolate a backbone effect.
In the coupling ablation, the nominal gain from decoupling is concentrated in entity recognition (58 → \rightarrow 62 of 72), but this category-level difference is descriptive; it rests on the same 200 questions.
blocks.zh:
表3b报告主要文件中的牌堆。 双子座3.0比较将较早的牵引和dev-200问题固定下来,改变了本地证据卡和全球概览框架是否进入规划者. 本地卡提高精度5分;加上全局帧将精度降低4分. 双子座3.8比较记录了178个没有卡的正确答案,180个有卡的Dev-200,1分增益. 双子座3.8卡比较只有汇总正确答案计数,因此没有报告不协调-pair计数或配对意义测试. 这些内骨结果支持紧凑的局部视觉内存,但早期的双子座3.0牵引与双子座3.8配置不同,并不孤立一个骨干效应.
在耦合法中,脱钩带来的名义收益集中于实体确认(72分之58 ~\rightarrow 62),但这一类别层面的差异是描述性的;它基于相同的200个问题.

blocks.en: Appendix G Video-GAIA protocol
blocks.zh: 附录G 视频-GAIA协议

blocks.en:
Video-GAIA has six domains: Culture, Daily Life, Economics, Geography, History and Technology.
We score it with a binary semantic judge against the reference answers, with one deviation from the benchmark protocol: the official protocol polls a primary and a fallback judge and averages three runs, while we judge once with a single Kimi K3 judge.
Both arms were run by us on the same 271 questions and scored by the same judge with the same
prompt and reference answers, so the paired comparison is internally consistent. The absolute
numbers are one draw of a stochastic judge – 80 questions were judged at temperature 0 and 191 at
temperature 1 – and should not be read against the public leaderboard.

blocks.en:
Four settings are not aligned between the arms: the baseline is allowed 40 steps
against our 24 turns; our Planner runs with its thinking stripped from the replayed context while
the official agent keeps it; and the measured run predates a fix to the bounding-box coordinate
convention shared by the Planner and the crop tool, so its crop path was reading boxes in the
wrong frame. The fourth concerns observation access: the official agent perceives 20 uniformly sampled frames, while
ours reads a duration-preserving proxy video for the global pass and native intervals locally.
Perception usage records are missing for 291 of 1,342 calls on our side, so we report no cost
comparison on this benchmark.
There is also development overlap: these 271 questions were also the set on which we developed the web-search tools and the crop protocol, so for VideoNexus they are not held out, and we read table 2 as a transfer result and a direction rather than a calibrated margin.

blocks.en:
Of the 37 v0 errors on dev-200, 15 stem from localization or fine-grained identity, 8 from counting or ordering across segments, and 3 from mapping correct evidence to the wrong option.
On the 153 questions VideoSeek misses and VideoNexus answers, VideoSeek took 8.5 steps against its own 6.2 average, called focus 630 times, and had scanned globally first on 76% of them: these traces show continued evidence seeking but do not identify sampling as the sole cause of failure.
On the 42 that go the other way, our trajectories make 214 inspect_frames calls in total and use Overview on 29 questions. Detailed local inspection can remain unsuccessful even after global navigation. Figure 2 in the main paper follows one question ( lvbench_10 ) through both kinds of call; appendix I gives five further complete trajectories, including a failure, and the behaviour of the loop over the full run.

blocks.en:
Figures 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 and 11 reproduce five complete trajectories from the full LVBench run reported in table 1 .
They are selected, not sampled: we chose them to show each kind of call doing its job (a count settled by one Overview and one Inspect, a Finding that contradicts the option the scene first suggests, several occurrences of an event told apart, two Findings that disagree on a count and the denser look that settles it) and one typical error.
Three of the four correct answers are on questions at least two baselines miss, which is not typical (VideoNexus is right and Gemini Agentic wrong on 57 questions, the reverse on 40); figure 12 shows questions drawn at random.
Calls, Planner thought summaries and Finding text are quoted verbatim from the trace and shortened only at […]; text in grey brackets is ours.
The Planner never receives the frames counted in teal; it receives the Finding and the evidence card shown beside each trajectory.

blocks.en:
The film has no dialogue, and its transcript holds 23 fragments of noise, so the Planner starts with Overview.
Overview points to two scenes: a ladybug rescue from a spider web at about 44–47 minutes, and mantises hunting ladybugs at about 68–71.
The web scene looks like option (A), which is the answer all three baselines give.
The Planner inspects it, and two high-resolution Findings report the sizes the other way round: the trapped ladybug is the smaller one, and the larger one rescues it.
The Planner notes the contradiction, runs Overview again with a new query, and inspects the mantis scene, where a smaller ladybug knocks a larger one out of the mantis’s claws.
Two earlier Findings on the web scene (steps 3 and 6) also see a larger ladybug caught on the web at the start of the scene; the two that look at the rescue itself agree on who saves whom, and the evidence cards bear them out.

blocks.en:
The video strings together auditions from several editions of a talent show, and nothing on screen numbers the contestants.
The transcript holds the lyrics of three songs before 4:20, and the Planner inspects the third: the sub-agent reads the caption, “Creep”, but reports uncertain on whether this is the third contestant rather than asserting it.
The Planner then reads the first two captions with two 30-frame Inspects; their songs are the distractors (B) and (D), and the lyrics leave no room for a fourth song before Creep.
All four systems answer correctly; we show it for the uncertain status, which marks exactly the part of the task the interval could not settle.

A one-minute, low-resolution Inspect reports four TV hoods after 05:45, Gemini Agentic’s answer, although its own box at 05:46 holds three; a high-resolution Inspect at 2 fps and a crop of that box report three.
A sparse pass over the preceding half minute then counts four hooded dancers, earlier in the song, and the Planner tracks them through 05:43–05:47 at 2 and 4 fps: three hoods remain in the last shot.

The question admits two boxes: a box of cards placed on the table at 05:24, and a case of pins at about 24:30, which the annotation and option (B) point to.
The Planner’s thought lists the transcript’s mentions of a box, and the pins are never called one.
Overview ranks the box of cards first and lists the pins fourth, as “context for the ‘Box of needles’ distractor”; the Planner inspects only the first candidate and answers (D).
Gemini Agentic and VideoSeek answer (B), Static (D).
Of the 35 wrong answers on which no Inspect overlaps the annotated window, 24 called Overview, and in 12 of these an Overview candidate covered the window and was never inspected.

blocks.en:
Figure 12 shows where the Planner spent its perception on twelve questions drawn at random.
On the eight correct ones, Inspect intervals sit on or next to the annotated window; where Overview was called, its candidates spread across the video and the Planner inspects one or two of them.
The four errors show the two ways the loop fails: three never inspect the annotated window, and one inspects it and still answers wrongly ( lvbench_545 , whose first Inspect covers the window).
Over the run, at least one Inspect interval overlaps the annotated window on 1,251 questions, of which 89.0% are answered correctly; on the 255 questions where every Inspect misses it, 86.3% are, so a missed window rarely means a failed question: the evidence a question needs can also appear outside the one window the benchmark annotates.
blocks.zh:
图12显示了规划人员在随机抽取的12个问题上的感知。
在8个正确位置上,检查间隔坐落在或旁边的注解窗口上;在叫"概览"的地方,其考生分布在视频中,计划员检查其中一两个.
4个错误显示了循环失败的两种方式:3个从未检查过附加说明的窗口,1个检查后仍然错误回答(lvbench_545,其第一个检查覆盖窗口).
在整个运行过程中,至少一个检查间隔与1,251个问题的注解窗口重叠,其中89.0%得到正确回答;在255个问题中,每个检查者都错过了它,86.3%,因此一个错过的窗口很少意味着一个失败的问题:一个问题需要的证据也可以出现在一个窗口外的基准注释.

blocks.en:
In figure 13 , the most common counts are three and four turns, and the mean is 6.1; 23 questions are answered from the transcript alone, 21 of them correctly.
After an ok Finding the Planner answers immediately 31% of the time, after an absent or uncertain one 14% and 16%; after 383 of the 560 absent Findings it inspects again.
Overview is called on 632 questions; 83.5% of them are answered correctly against 92.0% of the others, because the Planner calls Overview when the transcript does not locate the evidence, which also makes a question harder.
Neutral local tasks are asked for but not enforced: 441 of the 4,992 Inspect and crop tasks (8.8%) name two or more options as whole words, as step 7 of figure 10 does with counts from earlier Findings.

blocks.zh: 表8:dev-200上的VideoNexus v0和双子座3.0 Flash的组件喷发(  dev-100). 低透视分辨率使用比高低72.9%的图像符号;微弱的Skill 迅速削减 Planner输入量为46.8%的1.5分;证据关闭规则削减量为26.5%,成本为23.7%. 重复一个配置两次移动它3个问题(79个和100个中的82个),这就是本表的解析度.

blocks.en:
Table 8 summarizes design choices made during development with an earlier version of the harness.
Which visual information should reach the Planner was measured on the same subset and is reported in table 3 .
Forcing Overview to propose at least one candidate interval is better than letting it return none, and keeping the global timeline in addition to candidates is better than candidates alone.
Separate atomic tools outperform a single batched inspection tool by 5.5 points.
Low-resolution Inspect is as accurate as high resolution while using 72.9% fewer image tokens.
Giving Inspect the audio track and ASR improves accuracy by 2.5 points.
We also tested several prompt-level policies that tell the Planner how to sample (density hints, joint multi-window inspection, mandatory cropping, explicit evidence-state receipts, neutral-task rules in the tool schema, dedicated counting tools).
None provided convincing evidence of improvement on this development subset, and several reduced accuracy by 3–5 points; we report them as a group because no individual policy separated from the baseline.
These development results motivated a minimal policy that leaves observation choices to the Planner, without establishing that this policy is generally optimal.
Raising the turn limit from 10 to 14 was measured separately on 20 questions repeated three times and moved the mean from 10.00 to 10.67 correct while increasing tool calls by 32%, so the limit was left at the lower value.
blocks.zh:
表8总结了在开发过程中所作的设计选择,以及早先版本的吊带。
在同一个子集中测量了哪些视觉信息应提供给规划员,并在表3中报告。
强迫概览提出至少一个候选人间隔比让其不返回好,除了候选人之外,保留全球时间比单靠候选人好。
单独的原子工具比一个单一的批量检查工具多5.5分.
低分辨率 检查精度与高分辨率一样高,同时使用72.9%的图像符号.
检查音轨和ASR能提高2.5分的准确性。
我们还测试了数项迅速的政策,告诉规划人员如何取样(密度提示、联合多窗口检查、强制裁剪、明确的证据状态收据、工具计划中的中立任务规则、专用计数工具)。
没有任何证据表明这一发展子集有所改进,而且若干精确度降低了3-5点;我们作为一个群体加以报告,因为没有任何个别政策与基线分开。
这些发展成果促使一项将观察选择留给规划员的最低限度政策,但没有确定这项政策总体上是最佳的。
将转弯限制从10个提高到14个,在重复三次的20个问题上分别进行了测量,并将平均值从10.00移到10.67正确,同时将工具调用增加32%,所以这个限制被留到较低的值.

blocks.en: Appendix K When does an agent help?
blocks.zh: 附录K 特工什么时候能帮忙?

blocks.en:
Agentic perception is not free.
On LongVideoBench with Gemini 3.0, the earlier harness loses 2.1 points on 15-second clips and gains 1–3 points on videos longer than one minute.
On the long split of Video-MME, where the static model already reaches 85.2%, it loses 4.0 points.
Questions that depend on global temporal order (for example, ordering of scenes) are hurt by local inspection, whereas questions that require finding and identifying a specific entity or event benefit most.
These results suggest routing between static ingestion and the agent by video length and question type, which we leave to future work.
This block was measured on an earlier version of the harness than the one in the main paper, so we report it for the direction of the effect rather than its magnitude.
blocks.zh:
代理感知不是免费的。
在Long Viideo Bench和双子座3.0上,早先的拉带在15秒的剪辑上损失2.1分,在超过1分钟的视频上收获1–3分.
在Video-MME的长分裂上,静态模型已经达到85.2%,它损失4.0分.
取决于全球时间秩序的问题(例如场景的秩序)受到当地检查的伤害,而需要寻找和确定具体实体或事件的问题则最有利。
这些结果表明,静态摄入与剂之间的路由按视频长度和问题类型排列,我们留给今后的工作。
这个块是用比主论文中那个更早的版本的绳索来测量的,所以我们把它报告给效果的方向而不是其规模.

blocks.en: Appendix L Inside Gemini’s agentic mode
blocks.zh: 附录 L 双子座内置代理模式

blocks.en:
We analyzed traces of Gemini’s agentic media-processing mode on ten LVBench questions with Gemini 3.7 Flash, one of the documented models for this mode.
The responses expose 46 thought signatures, of which only the ten final ones are decodable, and 28 thought summaries.
On average the model performs 1.8 internal navigation steps per question.
Tool-use token accounting reports image and text tokens but no audio tokens, and for 1,311 of the 1,429 full-LVBench questions where the mode navigated at all (92%) the image-token count is an exact multiple of 66, the per-frame cost of low-resolution video; the remaining counts exceed a multiple of 66 by a small amount, so some navigated images are not plain low-resolution frames.
These observations suggest a server-side media index that offers timestamped transcripts and random access to frames, with the navigated frames returned into the reasoning model’s context.

我们用双子座3.7 Flash分析双子座的代理媒体处理模式,
这些答复揭露了46个思想签名,其中只有10个是可解码的,28个是思想摘要。
平均来说,该模型每个问题执行1.8个内部导航步骤。
工具使用令牌会计报告图像和文字令牌但没有音频令牌,对于1,429个全LV Bench问题中的1,311个问题,模式导航(92%)时,图像脚本计数是准确的66倍,是低分辨率视频的每帧成本;其余计数则小幅超过66倍,因此一些导航图像不是普通低分辨率帧.
这些观察表明,服务器侧媒体指数可以提供时间标记的文字记录和随机访问帧,导航帧返回推理模型的背景。

blocks.en:
Over the full LVBench run its navigation is transcript-first.
1,353 of the 1,549 thought summaries refer to the transcript, ASR or subtitles; the tool-use text tokens, which carry what it retrieves from the transcript, have a median of 16.6k per question; and it reads a median of 93 frames on questions whose annotated evidence window our transcript places speech in, against 286 on questions whose window has no speech.
A visual scan is available, and 447 thought summaries describe sparse or low-frame-rate scanning. Transcript-based navigation is frequent, but the traces do not establish why the model selects this strategy.
VideoNexus’s Overview makes the global scan cheap for the Planner, and the Planner uses it where the transcript cannot help: it fires on 29% of the questions whose evidence window contains speech, on 62% of those whose window does not, and on 81% of the questions about the 12 videos without an audio track ( figure 14 ).

blocks.en: Appendix M The native timeline probe
blocks.zh: 附录 M 本土时间线探测器

blocks.en:
VideoNexus’s Findings are only composable if every perception call reports time on the same clock, so we
checked what the perception model does when it is given an interval of a longer video rather than a
clip. Across 12 probe responses with neutral prompts – no instruction about which origin to use –
all 12 reported times on the absolute source timeline, including the 6 that were asked to state
their reference explicitly. The 6 responses given a physically cropped clip instead reported times
relative to that clip’s own start. We therefore pass intervals by timestamp and never hand the model
a pre-cut file, which removes the offset bookkeeping that clip-based harnesses need.

blocks.zh: 附录N 限制

blocks.en: Each Inspect adds a model request and can increase latency; the available measurements do not establish a matched wall-clock comparison with static ingestion. We do not report a wall-clock comparison against the baseline: in our own runs only 22 of 160 median seconds per question are recorded API time, the rest being local decode, transcode and upload, and the baseline’s per-call latency varied by 50% across hosts with load, so neither number isolates the harness.
blocks.zh: 每一次检查都增加了一个模型请求,并且可以增加耐久性;可用的测量结果没有建立匹配的壁时比对静态摄入. 我们没有报告与基线的时钟比较:在我们自己的运行中,每个问题只记录了 API 时间的22 个中位秒,其余的都是本地解码,转码和上传,基线的每个调用间隔在负载的东道主之间变化了50%,因此两个数字都无法隔离带子。

blocks.en:
A blind control given the question alone, with no video, audio or transcript, answers 40.5% of full LVBench ( table 1 ). This demonstrates substantial performance without video. The control uses the same high thinking level as the main arms; its accuracy neither bounds all possible text-only strategies nor provides a causal decomposition of multimodal performance.
The VideoSeek re-run answered 52 of the 1,549 questions without a perception call and was correct on 25 (48%). This self-selected subset further illustrates that some answers can be produced without viewing the video.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: VideoNexus reads the native audio track and an ASR transcript; the VideoSeek re-run, following its released configuration, reads neither, and its own subtitle path filters windows with a disjunction where a conjunction is intended, so enabling it would place the entire transcript in every call. We therefore report the no-speech slices separately ( appendix E ), where our margin is 3.9 points rather than the 8.7 it reaches where speech falls inside the evidence window – this variation cannot quantify the modality advantage because the question groups differ and speech elsewhere may still aid localization. 12 of LVBench’s 103 videos, covering 175 questions, carry no audio stream at all, so for those questions the asymmetry does not exist.

blocks.en:
The ablations of sections 4.4 , 4.6 and F are measured on the 200 dev questions used during development. Pairing controls question composition but does not remove development selection or configuration differences. These are not held-out results. We report discordant-pair counts where per-question records are available; the Gemini 3.8 card comparison has aggregate counts only.
The resumed baseline run also reveals answer variability: 55 of its 1,549 questions were answered twice at identical settings, and 7 of the 55 came back with a different answer, which cautions against overinterpreting small differences but does not estimate the variance of full-run accuracy. Where a duplicate exists we count the earliest-finished attempt, a rule fixed independently of whether it was correct.
Errors made inside a perception call persist unless the Planner decides to look again; overconfident absent findings and inconsistent counts across calls are the main residual errors.
All components are accessed through commercial APIs whose versions may change.
Development decisions were made on a 200-question subset of LVBench, which we report separately from full-set results.
On short clips and on questions that depend on the global order of events, a single static pass remains competitive or better.
blocks.zh:
第4.4、4.6和F节的缩写是根据开发期间使用的200个非问题来衡量的。 对齐控件质疑组成,但不会消除开发选择或配置差异. 这些结果没有被搁置。 我们报告有问题记录的不协调者-pair计数;双子座3.8卡的比较只有总计数。
恢复的基线运行还揭示了答案的变异性:在1 549个问题中,55个问题中有55个在相同的设置中两次得到回答,55个问题中有7个得到不同的回答,这告诫不要过度解释小差异,但不能估计全运行准确度的差异。 如果存在重复,我们数的是最早完成的尝试,这个规则与它是否正确无关。
除非规划人员决定再次查看,否则在感知呼吁中的错误依然存在;没有结论的过度自信和各种呼吁之间不一致的计数是主要的剩余错误。
所有组件都通过商业API访问,其版本可能会改变.
就LV Bench这一200个问题子集作出了发展决定,我们报告这些决定与全面确定的结果分开。
就短片和取决于全球事件顺序的问题而言,单一的静态通道仍然具有竞争力或更好。
